messages:
alex: Heads-up — saw a ~28% tokens/s regression on Mixtral-8k canary during yesterday's load test. FlashAttention is falling back to TritonSDPA for head_dim=48 on Hopper and register pressure kills perf.

maria: Oof. Can you repro and paste profiler output? Which GPU family?

alex: Repro on H100. Summary: when head_dim % 16 != 0 we reject optimized FA2 kernel, log fallback, and TritonSDPA ends up 2-3x slower on the attention op for long KV. Quick trace:
```
[2026-02-24T02:12:03Z] Model=Mixtral-8k v1.2
FlashAttention2: head_size=48 not supported by optimized kernel -> fallback to TritonSDPA
TritonSDPA_kernel: 1.31ms (avg)  // previously FlashAttention2 0.55ms
KV_cache_misses: +19%
Total_tokens/s: 720 -> 520
```
Also saw higher L2 traffic and register spills in the samples.

ben: Are batches mixing different model variants? Continuous batching + variable seq lengths can make per-batch kernel selection noisy.

riley: Repro loop I used:
```
for prompt in prompts:
  out = client.generate(model="mixtral-8k", prompt=prompt, max_tokens=64)
```
Config diffs we care about:
- mixtral: head_dim=48, rotary_dim=64, rope_scaling=dynamic
- mistral: head_dim=64, rotary_dim=64
- qwen: head_dim~56 depending on variant

jordan: For our compiled FA2 set we require head_dim % 16 == 0 on Hopper (we accept %8 on Ampere). head_dim=48 violates that so runtime rejects FA2 and falls back. TritonSDPA is less vectorized for long KV.

maria: Paste the nvprof flame sample of kernel times? Need kernel names and %s.

alex: Trimmed flame:
```
0.0s - cudaMemcpyAsync
0.1s - TritonSDPA_kernel (45%)
0.6s - kv_write_loop (12%)
0.8s - FlashAttention_check (8%)
1.0s - forward_linear (10%)
```
Previously FlashAttention_kernel was ~28% and no TritonSDPA at all.

ben: Two mitigations:
1) Pad head_dim to next multiple of 16 at compile/runtime and route to FA2, mapping KV into padded buffers.
2) Improve batching heuristic to group by (model.variant, head_dim_compatibility) before packing so mixed batches don't force fallback.

riley: Padding risks: KV cache stride mismatch and extra mem copies unless we store KV padded from allocation time. Proposed layout:
```
pad = ((head_dim + 15) // 16) * 16
kv_buf = alloc(batch, seq, heads, pad)
kv_buf[..., :head_dim] = raw_kv
kv_buf[..., head_dim:] = 0
```
Memory increase ~33% for 48->64, but keeps lookups simple.

jordan: Also watch RoPE: applying rotary before/after padding can change indexing and cause tiny numerical drift for RoPE-scaling workflows. Do RoPE scaling on unpadded dims, then copy into padded buffer.

maria: Suggest per-arch kernel requirement table: Ampere accept %8, Hopper require %16. Evaluate at compile/startup so selection isn't done per-batch.

alex: Patch plan:
- add arch->kernel_requirements table
- add compile-time pad parameter + runtime flag enable_padded_fa2
- write KV into padded buffers while keeping public cache layout opaque (handle mapping)
I'll open a PR with a canary flag.

deploy-bot: Canary created for mixtral-pad-fa2 on cluster: inference-canary-3 — traffic 5% -> 03:00 UTC

ben: Batching heuristic tweak: when batching window closes, split groups by (model_id, head_dim_compatibility) before packing. Avoid 50/50 mixes that force fallback on half the batch.

riley: Note: Qwen variants with head_dim=56 behave different on PCIe gen4 vs gen5 due to threadblock size limits; include PCIe/driver caps in selection policy.

maria: Local sim perf after padding approach:
```
mixtral-canary (pad->64, enable_padded_fa2)
Tokens/s: 730 -> 710 (was 520 with TritonSDPA fallback)
GPU_mem +12%
Latency p95 +8ms (padding memcpy)
```
Good tradeoff for throughput workloads.

alex: I'll run the full regression matrix (Llama / Mistral / Mixtral / Qwen) across Ampere/Hopper and collect per-arch numbers and RoPE-quality checks. If green, bump canary to 25% and watch eval metrics for RoPE drift.

jordan: FYI I'm prototyping a FA2 change that relaxes alignment checks for some head_dims using masked loads; could eliminate padding but needs correctness proofs and unit tests.

maria: Action items:
- alex: PR for runtime table + pad toggle + KV padded buffers
- ben: batching heuristic patch (split-by-compat)
- jordan: FA2 alignment PR draft
- riley: validation scripts for RoPE scaling + long context
I'll track in eng-runtime board. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks — I'll drop perf artifacts and nsight traces into the ticket once PR is opened.
